kitDescription: Kilo is a Fire MG Defender whose whole kit keys off one self-status, Nano Coating. At battle start she gains a continuous self-shield equal to 21.12% of her final Max HP. While coated, every 200 normal attacks she repairs the shield for 2.85% of her Max HP, and her burst becomes an AoE nuke dealing 1150.84% of an ATK value derived from 5% of her final Max HP. If she ever bursts while uncoated, she instead buffs her own Max HP by 48% for 20 seconds, re-applies the coating, and stacks escalating Next-Shield-HP bonuses. Since nothing at scope lock ever damages her, the coating never breaks and only the coated branches of the kit ever fire.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: every divergent or unexpressed line is documented verbatim with a reason, and all six kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP. The single S5 RED (S2-a shield restore) is a disposition disagreement, not a gotcha — both blind agents wanted a hitCount-200 shield event under the tandem-completeness rule, but the prose says 'Restores Shield HP' (a pool top-up, not a new application), no shield HP pool exists in v1, and the driver's contamination argument (heal -> Crown recovery misfire; fresh shield -> shielded-trigger re-fire every 200 rounds) is one the blind agents' own notes concede; the driver's UNMODELED-plus-verbatim is the more defensible reading and the contract treats a reasoned `unmodeled` as DOCUMENTED_GAP. The burst nuke's routing (burstCast, requiresShielded, pre-FB, no core, no range) is faithful and hard-discriminated (helm co-B3 trigger split; shield-free fixture C gate proof); its HP-derived ATK basis is the kit's one real residual and is exactly the documented ⚑ + recipe case the contract scopes out — the driver shipped the prose's printed multiplier and flagged the ~52% undercount rather than fabricating S6's 4.1x-low 575 placeholder, which is the MEASURED > FUDGE rule working as intended. Convergence is otherwise strong: S1 shield, both dead-branch unmodeled sets, and all S5 behavioral burst assertions agree across three independent agents. For GO nothing must change; the owner should spot-check two same-model residuals: (1) the HP-basis popup recipe actually gets run (a ~2x-higher burst popup confirms and calls for an engine primitive — both documented infidelities, basis and ATK-buff coupling, collapse together), and (2) the engine's shieldedUntilFrame window is not name-keyed to Nano Coating, so in any future comp where kilo's shield could break while a teammate shields her, requiresShielded would over-open the coated gate — unobservable at scope today, noted for the day shield-breaking is modeled.
